contracts.canonicalDigest: The effect digest binds durable operation identity to the exact final-use tuple.
contracts.authorityIdentity: Principal, action, scope, policy revision, quota and operation ID are checked before dispatch.
contracts.ambiguousOutcome: Transport ambiguity after dispatch preserves an indeterminate reservation and forbids blind refund.

contracts.correlation: Reservation ID, operation ID, request digest and terminal evidence digest connect control and provider observations.
